source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the synapse (PDF 33).

blocks.text: Synapse aik neuron ke axon terminal aur doosre neuron ke dendrites ya muscle ya gland ke effector cell ka jor hai. Dono cells aapas mein nahi chhoote: mayi se bhara khala, synaptic cleft, unhein juda rakhta hai. Synapse ki taraf action potentials bhejne wala neuron presynaptic neuron aur doosri taraf ka cell postsynaptic cell hai.

blocks.title: Neuromuscular junction
blocks.text: Motor neuron aur muscle fibre ke synapse ko neuromuscular junction bhi kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Synapse par presynaptic aur postsynaptic cells ko kya juda karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Synaptic cleft, mayi se bhara tang khala.

items: Synapse: presynaptic neuron aur postsynaptic cell ke darmiyan mayi bhare cleft ke paar jor.
